research_question: Are the weak 1D/3D direction results primarily consistent with information loss from binary UP/DOWN target representation, such that a continuous-return model shows more stable causal predictive content, or do both binary and continuous representations fail under the current information set?
literature_basis: Dichotomizing a continuous outcome discards information and can materially reduce statistical efficiency; the audit therefore compares direct binary direction prediction with continuous-return prediction under the same information blocks.
Probabilistic forecasting should characterize uncertainty and be evaluated with proper scores; a future distributional model is justified only if continuous predictive content exists first.
Selective classification can trade coverage for lower risk, but abstention is not introduced until base predictive information is demonstrated.

Information-theoretic predictability literature motivates asking how much forecastable structure exists before adding model complexity; V1.69 does not claim to estimate a true information-theoretic upper bound.

source_artifact.immutability: Use frozen V1.64 panel only. No external data fetch or post-score feature creation.

targets.maturity_rule: Training rows at origin t require target_date < origin_date_t.
targets.boundary_rule: Evaluation target_date must remain inside the evaluation period.

model_lock.binary_model: training-only median imputation -> StandardScaler -> LogisticRegression L2

temporal_design.forward_rule: For every origin, fit using all target-matured rows strictly before that origin. No future-period training.

benchmarks.binary: Causal expanding matured UP frequency; fallback 0.5 if fewer than 20 matured labels.
benchmarks.continuous_mae: Causal expanding matured historical median return; fallback 0.0 if fewer than 20 matured returns.
benchmarks.continuous_mse: Causal expanding matured historical mean return; fallback 0.0 if fewer than 20 matured returns.

magnitude_diagnostic.threshold_source: Absolute continuous returns from rows target-matured by 2024-09-25, separately for each horizon.
magnitude_diagnostic.thresholds: 33rd and 67th percentiles, frozen before bridge/visible-period scoring.
magnitude_diagnostic.use: Ex-post failure attribution only. Realized magnitude is never an origin-time predictor and cannot be used for deployment or selection in V1.69.

decision_lock.continuous_bridge_pass_binary_bridge_fai: Support target-representation redesign: next study may model continuous/distributional return and derive direction/NO_SIGNAL under a separately frozen contract.
decision_lock.both_bridge_pass: Prefer the simpler/stabler representation only under a separately frozen comparison; no hybrid in V1.69.
decision_lock.both_bridge_fail: Current information set does not show sufficient transportable signal under either target representation; prioritize new information or horizon redesign rather than more adaptation complexity.
decision_lock.large_move_only_signal: If strong performance appears only in ex-post LARGE moves, this may motivate a separately frozen material-move/selective target study, but V1.69 may not tune a deadband threshold.
